To achieve Accomplished, ensure your technical explanations are accurate: equatorial rotation penalises retrograde Sun-synchronous orbits rather than boosting them, and RAAN is an inertial reference, not launch longitude. Also, resolve duplicate entries in the STK access table and finish the truncated sentence in your EOL discussion.","C3":"Your conclusion neatly synthesised your major mission decisions, linking the Vega E launcher, orbital regime, and ground station capability directly back to reef monitoring goals.
